component-o.description-s: MHF4 plug to RP-SMA female bulkhead jumper cable (with spring washer), 100 mm of 0.81 mm black coax (116 mm overall), 50 ohm, 0-8 GHz, 0.63 dB loss at 2 GHz. The antenna cable for ST67W611M1A6UTR's MHF4 receptacle out to a panel RP-SMA jack; takes an RP-SMA male antenna (W1030). Family lengths 100 / 200 / 250 mm (W9037BD0100 / -0200 / -0250).

connector-o.mates_with_series_s: I-PEX MHF4 receptacle (20449-001E class); RP-SMA male plug antennas
connector-o.source_s: Pulse W9037BDXXXX datasheet issue 1901 (pages 1-2: connectors, 0.81 mm cable, length table, attenuation table)
